'''Craxtet Redhand''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who was the second in command of the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]] under [[Big Jak Targrim]]. He earned his name because he wore a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Crushgaunt/Legends|crushgaunt]].
